```{r - Summarize Gene Expression Data}

gene_summary_func <- function(gene, gene_data){ 
  
  gene_data_subset <- gene_data %>%
    filter(gene_name == gene) # Subset data to our gene of interest
  
  # Compute mean, median, max, min, std dev, and IQR
  gene_summary <- gene_data_subset %>%
   summarise( # Use tidy summarize across our rows
    mean = mean(c_across(-gene_name)), # c across allows us to use the tidy function here without reformatting out data
    median = median(c_across(-gene_name)),
    sd = sd(c_across(-gene_name)),
    max = max(c_across(-gene_name)),
    min = min(c_across(-gene_name)),
    IQR = IQR(c_across(-gene_name))
  )
  
  return(gene_summary)
}

covariate_summary_func <- function(metadata, covariate){
  
  covariate_summary <- metadata %>%
    select(!!sym(covariate)) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(!!sym(covariate), na.rm = T),
      median = median(!!sym(covariate), na.rm = T),
      sd = sd(!!sym(covariate), na.rm = T),
      max = max(!!sym(covariate), na.rm = T),
      min = min(!!sym(covariate), na.rm = T),
      IQR = IQR(!!sym(covariate), na.rm = T)
    )
  
  return(covariate_summary)
}

selected_gene = "TP53" # Allow us to change gene as needed
selected_gene2 <- "BRCA1"
covariate_to_summarize <- "age_at_index"

summary_tp53 <- gene_summary_func(selected_gene, proj_data$counts_v2) 
summary_brca1 <- gene_summary_func(selected_gene2, proj_data$counts_v2)
summary_age<- covariate_summary_func(proj_data$metadata, covariate_to_summarize)

print(summary_tp53)
print(summary_brca1)
print(summary_age)

# Bind the rows together and add the Gene names back
combined_summary_genes <- bind_rows(
  mutate(summary_tp53, Gene = "TP53"),
  mutate(summary_brca1, Gene = "BRCA1")
) %>%
  select(Gene, everything()) # Reorder to put Gene first

# Generate Latex code 
# Generate the LaTeX table
latex_code_genes <- combined_summary_genes %>%
  kbl(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    digits = 2, # Round numbers to 2 decimal places
    caption = "Summary Statistics for TP53 and BRCA1 Expression Across Samples",
    label = "gene_stats",
    col.names = c("Gene", "Mean", "Median", "Std. Dev.", "Max", "Min", "IQR")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position")) # Keeps the table from floating away

latex_code_age <- summary_age %>%
  kbl(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    digits = 2, # Round numbers to 2 decimal places
    caption = "Summary Statistics for Cohort Age",
    label = "age_stats",
    col.names = c("Mean", "Median", "Std. Dev.", "Max", "Min", "IQR")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position")) # Keeps the table from floating away


# Print the LaTeX code to your console
print(latex_code_genes)
print(latex_code_age)
```

```{r - Visualize Data}

selected_gene2 <- "BRCA1" # Set gene to plot first gene against 
covariate <- "prior_treatment" # Set covariate

gene_visualize_func <- function(gene1, gene2, gene_data, metadata, covariate = NULL){
  
  gene1_data_subset <- gene_data %>% 
    filter(gene_name == gene1) # Build gene1 data for histogram
  
  gene1_2_data_subset <- gene_data %>%
    filter(gene_name %in% c(gene1, gene2)) %>% # Subset gene data to two genes of interest from scatter
    pivot_longer( # Pivot format so it can be used easily in ggplot scatter
      cols = -gene_name,
      names_to = "sample_id",
      values_to = "expression_value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      expression_value = log2(expression_value + 1)
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = gene_name,
      values_from = expression_value
    )
  
  # Pivot for plotting
  
  gene1_long_subset <- gene1_data_subset %>%
  pivot_longer( # Pivot to a gene 1 long dataset for plotting and easy joining to metadata covariate
    cols = -gene_name,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "expression_value"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id_clean = gsub("\\.", "-", sample),
         expression_value = log2(expression_value + 1)) # Need to reformat the sample ID so it matches our metadata ID names
  
  # Add the metadata covariate
  
  if (is.null(covariate)) { # Check for covariate being set or not
  plotting_data_gene1 <- gene1_long_subset
  } else {
  merging_data <- metadata %>%
    select(barcode, !!sym(covariate)) %>% # Need to find the column symbol from the provided covariate string
    dplyr::rename(sample_id_clean = barcode, # Rename so it can be joined easily to our gene expression data
           covariate_value = !!sym(covariate)) # Set name of the covariate column 

  plotting_data_gene1 <- gene1_long_subset %>%
    left_join(merging_data, by = "sample_id_clean")
  } # Join gene1 expressiond data with covariate for plotting
  
  # Build Histogram
  histogram <- ggplot(plotting_data_gene1, aes(x = expression_value)) + 
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 10, # Set bin size
      fill = "darkgreen",
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.7 # Set alpha for transparency
    ) +
    labs( # set labeling
      title = paste("Expression:", gene1),
      x = "Expression Value",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
   theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme( # Format size of title and labels
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 8
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"), # Bold axis titles
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank() # Remove extra gridlines
  )
  
  # Build Scatter Plot
  
  scatter_plot <- ggplot(
    gene1_2_data_subset,
      aes(
        x = .data[[gene1]], # Set x and y for scatter 
        y = .data[[gene2]]
      )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      color = "darkgreen",
      alpha = 0.6 # Set transparency for better readability of data density
  ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(gene1, "vs", gene2), # Set title
        x = gene1,
        y = gene2
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme( # Set formatting for label and text
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 8
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"), # Bold axis titles
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank() # Remove extra gridlines
  )
  
  # Build Violin Plot
  
  covariate_string <- str_replace_all(covariate, "_", " ")

  violin_plot <- ggplot(
  plotting_data_gene1,
  aes(
    x = expression_value,
    y = covariate_value  # Set covariate to measure by
  )
) +
  geom_violin( # Set theme formats 
    fill = "darkgreen",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7,
    scale = "width"
  ) +
  geom_jitter( # Use jitter to plot actual distinct datapoints
    width = 0.1, 
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = "blue",
    size = 1
  ) +
  labs( # Set labeling
    title = paste(gene1, "by", covariate_string),
    x = "Expression Value",
    y = covariate_string
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme( # Set formatting for label and text
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 8
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
  
  grid.arrange( # Put all plots on the same plane, two columns 
    histogram,
    scatter_plot,
    violin_plot,
    ncol = 2
  )
}

png("gene_plots.png", width = 6, height = 4.5, units = "in", res = 300)

gene_visualize_func(selected_gene, selected_gene2, proj_data$counts_v2,
                                          proj_data$metadata, covariate) # Display plots for our genes and covariate

dev.off()

```



```{r - Heatmap}

set.seed(456) # Set seed for reproducibility of the gene sample

selected_genes_heatmap <- proj_data$counts %>% # Sample a set of genes for our heatmap
  dplyr::slice_sample(n = 10)

heatmap_genes_list <- selected_genes_heatmap$gene_name # create list for function input
  
covariate_heatmap <- "prior_treatment" # set covariate

gene_heatmap_func <- function(gene_list, gene_data, metadata, covariate){
  
  covariate_string <- str_replace_all(covariate, "_", " ")
  
  gene_heatmap_data_subset <- gene_data %>%
    filter(gene_name %in% gene_list) # filter data to the listed genes
    
    
  rownames(gene_heatmap_data_subset) <- gene_heatmap_data_subset[[1]] # set rownames for matrix in heatmap
  
  gene_heatmap_data_subset <- gene_heatmap_data_subset %>%
    select(-gene_name) # remove the genename so we have a clean matrix for the heatmap

  # 1. Get and sort covariate data by the covariate value
  covariate_ordered <- metadata %>%
    select(barcode, !!sym(covariate)) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(sample_id = barcode, covariate_value = !!sym(covariate)) %>%
    mutate(sample_id_clean = gsub("\\-", ".", sample_id)) %>% 
    select(sample_id_clean, covariate_value) %>%
    # Filter to only keep metadata for samples that actually exist in the matrix columns
    filter(sample_id_clean %in% colnames(gene_heatmap_data_subset)) %>%
    # This orders your annotation bar cleanly
    arrange(covariate_value) 
  
  # 2. Reorder the matrix columns to match the sorted metadata
  gene_heatmap_data_subset <- gene_heatmap_data_subset %>%
    select(all_of(covariate_ordered$sample_id_clean))

  # 3. Create the annotation object exactly matched to the new order
  annotation_data <- covariate_ordered %>%
    select(covariate_value) 
    
  rownames(annotation_data) <- covariate_ordered$sample_id_clean
  
  annotation_data <- covariate_ordered %>%
    select(covariate_value) # select the value alone 
    
  rownames(annotation_data) <- covariate_ordered$sample_id_clean # set rownames
  
  covariate_levels <- unique(na.omit(annotation_data$covariate_value)) # Get unique non-missing covariate categories

  # Generate named colors for covariate to use in the heatmap annotation label
  covariate_colors <- setNames(
    circlize::rand_color(length(covariate_levels)),
    covariate_levels
  )

  # Create annotation
  column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Covariate = annotation_data$covariate_value, # values to annotate
    col = list(
      Covariate = covariate_colors # Set colors for annotation
    ),
    na_col = "grey", # set NA covariate values to grey
    annotation_legend_param = list( # add size of legend
      Covariate = list(
        title = covariate_string,
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 6, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
        grid_width = grid::unit(0.2, "cm"),
        grid_height = grid::unit(0.2, "cm")
      )
    )
  )
  
  # Scale data because the selected genes have very different expression levels, making it hard to interpret
  
  gene_heatmap_matrix <- log2(
    as.matrix(gene_heatmap_data_subset) + 1 # use a Log2 scale to make proportional changes look linear
  )
    
  Heatmap( # run heatmap function with our matrix of data
    as.matrix(gene_heatmap_matrix), 
    name = "Expression Values",
    width = unit(4.5, "cm"),
    height = unit(5, "cm"),
    top_annotation = column_ha, # add annotation data
    show_row_names = TRUE, # shows genes on the rows
    show_column_names = FALSE, # don't show columns, because we have over 1200 samples
    cluster_columns = FALSE, # similarly don't cluster samples due to amount
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    column_title = "Samples",
    row_title = "Genes",
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Count",
      title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
      labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
      direction = "horizontal"
      )
    )
}

png("heatmap.png", width = 6, height = 4.5, units = "in", res = 300)


gene_heatmap_func(heatmap_genes_list, proj_data$counts,
                    proj_data$metadata, covariate_heatmap)


dev.off()

```

```{r - Volcano}

# 1. Expression matrix setup
counts_df <- proj_data$counts
gene_names <- counts_df$gene_name

counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_df %>% select(-gene_name))
rownames(counts_matrix) <- gene_names

# 2. Metadata setup (dynamically maps covariate to 'treatment')
covariate <- "prior_treatment"  # Set your target covariate here

metadata <- proj_data$metadata %>%
  select(barcode, !!sym(covariate)) %>%   # Added missing pipe here
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id = barcode, 
    treatment = !!sym(covariate)         # Renamed directly to 'treatment' to match downstream code
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample_id_clean = gsub("\\-", ".", sample_id)) %>% 
  select(sample_id_clean, treatment) %>%
  filter(treatment %in% c("Yes","No")) %>% # Filter down to the two covariate groups of interest 
  as.data.frame()

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample_id_clean

# 3. FIX: Filter and align counts matrix to match the filtered metadata samples
# Keep only columns that exist in our clean metadata, in the exact same order
counts_matrix <- counts_matrix[, rownames(metadata), drop = FALSE]

# Validate alignment
stopifnot(identical(rownames(metadata), colnames(counts_matrix)))

# Ensure treatment groups are a correctly ordered factor
# Note: Ensure "Control" and "Treatment" exactly match the string values in your data
metadata$treatment <- factor(
  trimws(as.character(metadata$treatment)),
  levels = c("Yes", "No") 
)

if (anyNA(metadata$treatment)) {
  stop("Treatment contains missing or unexpected values. Check your metadata labels.")
}

# 3. Run DESeq2 Pipeline
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_matrix,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ treatment
)

#dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("treatment", "No", "Yes"))
results_df <- as.data.frame(res)
results_df$gene_name <- rownames(results_df)

# 4. Filter and Prep Data for Volcano Plot
volcano_data <- results_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange))

png("volcano_plot.png", width = 7, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)

# 5. Generate Enhanced Volcano Plot
EnhancedVolcano(
  volcano_data,
  lab = volcano_data$gene_name,
  x = "log2FoldChange",
  y = "padj",                  # Using adjusted p-values

  # Significance thresholds
  pCutoff = 0.05,
  FCcutoff = 1.0,

  # Labels and formatting
  title = "Differential Gene Expression",
  subtitle = "No Prior Treatment vs Prior Treatment",
  xlab = bquote(~Log[2] ~ "Expression Value Change"),
  ylab = bquote(~-Log[10] ~ "Adjusted P-value"), # Explicitly labeling it as adjusted

  # Legend Labels
  legendLabels = c(
    "Not Significant", 
    "High Expression Change", 
    "Significant", 
    "Significant & High Expression Change"
  ),
  legendLabSize = 8,       # legend text size
  legendIconSize = 1.5,     # legend icon size
  
  # Formatting
  pointSize = 2.0,
  labSize = 4.0,

  # Visual enhancements to prevent overlapping text
  drawConnectors = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.5,
  colConnectors = 'black',
  max.overlaps = 20
)

dev.off()
```
